title: A Knight of Lothen
description:
OverviewLothen has fallen.
Monsters roam its lands, and something far darker stirs beneath the ruins. Answering the king’s call, you are Sir Dorian Ester, a lone knight sent to reclaim a kingdom on the brink of collapse.

Core gameplayA Knight of Lothen is a metroidvania where exploration and combat go hand in hand.

Traverse a connected world, unlock new abilities, and discover powerful items that open new paths, secrets, and challenges.

World / settingSet in Vitallia, a dark medieval world shaped by war, and powerful history. From ruined strongholds to cursed wilderness, each area hides fragments of a larger story waiting to be uncovered.

Features• Fast-Paced combat

• Original Heavy Metal Music

• Atmospheric pixel world

• Sword & Sorcery theme

Who it's forDesigned for players who enjoy exploration-driven action and mastering combat through skill and progression.

Inspired by classic action adventures and metroidvanias.
description_short: A dark fantasy metroidvania fueled by heavy metal. Fight, explore, and carve your path through the ruined kingdom of Lothen.
